# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 17 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Residential Market & New Supply

- **HDB resale prices dip while condo prices climb, squeezing upgraders** - The HDB resale price index fell in 2Q 2026 while private condo prices rose, with observers noting the two markets may be moving in opposite directions and widening the affordability gap for those looking to upgrade. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-prices-are-falling-while-condo-prices-rise-but-upgraders-have-a-bigger-problem/)

- **Two new GLS sites in Marina South and Orchard Boulevard could add around 500 homes** - The government has launched tenders for a 37,006 sq ft plot at Orchard Boulevard and a 64,663 sq ft site at Marina Gardens Lane, with analysts expecting strong developer bids given recent sales momentum. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/2-prime-residential-sites-released-orchard-marina-south/)

## HDB Resale & Upgrader Sentiment

- **Survey: only 55% of HDB owners still aspire to private housing** - A 2026 PropNex survey of 1,530 HDB owners found that accessibility and neighbourhood ties now outweigh prestige in upgrading decisions, with just 55.1% of respondents still targeting private property as their next home. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-what-77-of-hdb-owners-want-most-in-their-next-home-and-its-not-price-or-space/)

- **Clementi Crest has set the town's HDB resale price record twice since entering the market** - The project only reached its Minimum Occupation Period in 2025 and has already pushed up Clementi's resale benchmarks repeatedly within just over a year of becoming eligible for resale. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-crest-hdb-resale-record-prices/)

## Lease Decay & Buyer Considerations

- **Lease decay increasingly affects CPF usage, financing, and resale prospects as housing stock ages** - A Q&A piece outlines how a shortening remaining lease on older properties can affect a buyer's ability to use CPF, secure a loan, and find future buyers, with the issue growing more prominent as Singapore's housing stock gets older. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ask-an-agent-your-lease-decay-property-questions-answered/)
